authorization.basis: Existing owner authorization for autonomous unchanged-stock DC tests and Pacman capture; latest instruction to correct camera settings before recording and continue. This is not a new synthetic-profile approval.
authorization.scope: Factory OFF plus UI repaint -> factory ON plus same DBV3600 -> open/cancel native Screen timeout chooser without preference changes or another DSI table -> factory OFF plus repaint. Four7s holds,120Hz requested,manual100us/ISO6400/focus restored. Native packet/return/error checks, stock recovery and original target policy restoration. No hybrid,flash,persistence or extra register value.
authorization.question: Does a visible pixel-frame update reproduce the native-UI optical effect after full unmodified ON, when runtime transport fields and same-DBV writes already match?
